CD Projekt Red released The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered on Sept. 29, a free (on most platforms) update to the classic 2015 RPG that brings massive improvements to the game’s graphics, plus some much-needed fixes to gameplay elements. It’s no surprise, then, that Geralt’s most famous adventure is suddenly the highest-rated game of 2026 (well, on a technicality). I chose to start my latest foray into The Witcher 3 with the largest of its two expansions, Blood and Wine , which sends Geralt to the France-inspired nation of Toussaint. Brian Pollack, a licensed clinical social worker and certified eating disorders specialist at Hilltop Behavioral Health in Summit, New Jersey, specializes in treating males who struggle with eating disorders, which he said is "highly underreported." Days after Sylvester Stallone revealed his own history with bulimia, experts are highlighting a growing but often overlooked rise in eating disorders among men. The Academy Award-nominated actor, 80, revealed during an interview with The New York Times that he developed an "obsession" with eating habits while prepping for his role in the 1982 movie "Rambo." Stallone said he took pains to appear more "animalistic," drawing inspiration from jaguars and cats. "It became an obsession. Really bad. It got to the point where I became bulimic," he said during the interview. SYLVESTER STALLONE REVEALS SURPRISING HEALTH STRUGGLE BEHIND HIS FAMOUSLY RIPPED PHYSIQUE Bulimia nervosa is an eating disorder marked by episodes of binge-eating — consuming a large amount of food while feeling a loss of control — followed by purging behaviors such as vomiting, excessive use of laxatives or diuretics, fasting or excessive exercise, according to the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH).

items.article: Does trustworthy Amol Rajan have what it takes to lie and betray? Or will Acaster's nervy energy and unpredictability earn his survival? The Celebrity Traitors is the best gig in British broadcasting . Everyone wants to have a go, as is obvious from the second series’ ridiculously good cast, but something that is easily forgotten in the five – yes, five – months of excitement since it was announced is how quickly it can be over, no matter how much of a “big dog” you are. It is the best gig in British broadcasting, but also the most brutal – where you may not last more than an episode and disappointment, vulnerability and resentment loom. Even the stars can come away feeling short-changed. And so, we ended the very first episode with a savage cliffhanger: one of the two biggest bookings are getting the chop. In the dead of night, Amol Rajan , the ubiquitous broadcaster who just left the Today programme , was summoned to the old stone chapel where he stood, shivering in a shearling jacket in honour of his beloved Del Boy, to meet the Traitors face-to-face and plead for his salvation. Next to him, heart also sinking, was an uneasy James Acaster , one of the most accomplished stand-ups of his generation. Both men wound up lying in coffins awaiting their fate. One will be given a Traitors cloak; the other will have a coffin lid slammed in their face. items.article: From mid-length styles to glossy shine and ultra-long hair, these are the celebrity inspired haircuts perfect for women over 60 One look at recent red carpets and runway shows and it's clear the era of women in midlife feeling they have to cut their hair short is well and truly over. From Sarah Jessica Parker's waist-length hair to Nicole Kidman and Sandra Bullock's long locks in Practical Magic 2 , our A-listers are proving there's no rule when it comes to hair in midlife and beyond. To inspire your next salon appointment, we spoke to celebrity stylist and owner of Soho's Salon 64 , Ricky Walters, for his take on the most flattering haircuts for midlife women. While long hair is all the rage for A-listers, it's not the most practical for us mere mortals, which is why mid-length manes are the go-to for many of us. "Very long, heavy hair can sometimes feel ageing, but equally, an overly structured, 'strict history teacher' bob can have the same effect. On the other hand, mid-length hair is almost always a wonderfully flattering choice for a more mature woman," Ricky says. On the beauty of a mid-length cut, Ricky says it strikes the perfect balance of polished and sophisticated, but still youthful and effortless. "Soft, gentle layering, particularly around the face, is key, as it creates movement and softness rather than making the style feel too severe," he says.

items.article: Some shakiness after exercising is typical, but there’s a critical difference between “jello legs” and feeling sore and hurt days later. There’s a rite of passage when you start a new exercise routine or sport: following your workout, parts of your body may wobble like jelly. While this experience can happen even with pros, Andrew Jagim , an exercise physiologist at the University of Wisconsin, said that “jelly legs” are especially common with beginners who are not used to working out. “Even doing body-weight squats for five minutes could be enough to make their legs start shaking and quivering,” he said. Even though this is a natural physiological reaction, it’s still something you’ll want to watch. Unsteady muscles after you use your maximum effort are part of your body’s cry for some rest. From an athletic trainer’s perspective, the signal means: “Hey, it’s time to sit down. Don’t go hurt yourself,” said Patrick Maloney , the lead athletic trainer at Tulane Institute of Sports Medicine in New Orleans. When this physical shakiness occurs, it means your nerves are short-circuiting and are having trouble communicating with your muscles, Jagim said, because of the rapid onset of fatigue your training is causing. So your body “can’t initiate muscle contraction and relaxing like it normally does,” Jagim explained.
